文藝復興 Renaissance!

這是一本距離現在快25年的本子了，好像是C63的，不確定。
這是個千喜年前後的的IP的同人本，B站(Bilibili)有片源，有興趣的朋友可以去看看~

This is a Sister Princess doujinshi published back in 2002(Presumed C63). It was a truly amazing era for the ACG world—a golden age where countless legendary artists and timeless classics emerged.
The heroine of this doujinshi is Karen, one of the most beloved sisters of the franchise~
